title: Сел на пять минут

The master cat has a smooth round cream head outline, smooth cheeks, no hairstyle, no bangs, no ruff. Match image 2's exact head shape, face proportions, placement and shape of large dark oval eyes, triangular nose, smiling mouth, two short cheek marks per side, ears, pink ear interiors, chunky rounded paws and smooth curved tail. Match the master's broad green student cap silhouette, red band, round gold button and thick dark forest-green contours.
